_doc: Wf-43 Phase 2 — metric → real-tool routing policy. Every metric must be produced by the primary_tool (or one of the fallback_tools). NO MOCK FALLBACK IS PERMITTED. Mocks are reserved for unit-test fixtures only. The companion human-readable document is molmetal/scoring/ROUTING_POLICY.md.
_invariant: Every metric in this policy either returns a value computed by a real, locally-deployed tool, or it raises AdapterUnavailable. NO mock fallback is permitted at any layer.

_env_vars.MOLMETAL_VINA_ENGINE: Selects vina backend for vina_score / vina_high_affinity / vina_min_score. unset → AutoDock Vina 1.2.7 (real Meeko+Python or CLI), 'qvina2' → QuickVina 2 CLI, 'gpu' → Vina-GPU (CUDA + vina_gpu extension).

fallback_conditions.vina_qvina2: env MOLMETAL_VINA_ENGINE=qvina2 AND qvina02 on PATH
fallback_conditions.vina_gpu: env MOLMETAL_VINA_ENGINE=gpu AND CUDA device + vina_gpu extension

vina_score.notes: Real Meeko+Vina Python binding (preferred) or vina CLI binary. Switch engines via MOLMETAL_VINA_ENGINE.

vina_high_affinity.notes: Boolean classifier on top of vina_score (cutoff_kcal, default -8.0).

vina_min_score.notes: Aggregates vina_score over a batch — min / median / n_below_cutoff.

vina_qvina2.notes: Routes through q_vina2_swap.py calling qvina02 binary on PATH. The vendored copy at references/SoftMol/gated_mcts/utils/docking/qvina02 is the Wf-43 fallback binary path. Routes via MOLMETAL_VINA_ENGINE=qvina2.

fallback_conditions.vina_score: no CUDA device OR no vina_gpu extension present

vina_gpu.notes: GPU-accelerated Vina; same kcal/mol semantics as vina_score. The QuickVina2-GPU-2-1 binary at references/SynFlowNet/bin/ is the AMD-friendly vendor build (not NVIDIA Blackwell). Use vina_score as fallback when no CUDA. Routes via MOLMETAL_VINA_ENGINE=gpu.

vina_reference.notes: Re-docks the co-crystal ligand into the staged pocket to compute the binding-mode reference kcal/mol. Same engine as vina_score.

fallback_conditions.flowdock_pose: torch_cluster / torch_scatter unavailable OR DiffDock checkpoint missing

diffdock_pose.notes: Real DiffDock inference; confidence ∈ [0, 1]. GPU + torch_cluster required.

equibind_pose.notes: EquiBind adapter not yet shipped in this repo. Use flowdock_pose or diffdock_pose as SE(3)-equivariant docking surrogate. Adapter pending — ship molmetal/molmetal_lam/sbdd_env/equibind_adapter.py then wire a wrapper here.

flowdock_pose.notes: Real flow-matching docking confidence ∈ [0, 1]. CPU-friendly fallback when DiffDock GPU stack is unavailable.

pocket2mol.notes: Real Pocket2Mol sampler; atom-count is the validity proxy. Requires official Pocket2Mol weights at the path returned by pocket2mol_adapter._checkpoint_path().

boltz_affinity.primary_tool: D-MPNN pIC50 (R17 ship, locally-trained attentive fp)
boltz_affinity.notes: Real locally-trained Attentive D-MPNN pIC50 predictor; nan on parse-fail or missing checkpoint. Swap to Boltz foundation-model pIC50 head when shipped.

af2_confidence.notes: Real voxelization complexity proxy (deterministic std-of-tile-occupancy). Swap to AlphaFold pLDDT inference when the AF2 backend is shipped.

pb_pass_rate.notes: Real PoseBusters 26-check validation (14 chemistry + 12 protein-aware in 'dock' mode; 14 chemistry-only in 'mol' mode).

fallback_conditions.smarts_synthesis_gate: AiZynthFinder not installed — uses SMARTS rule from synthesis_gate module instead (deterministic, less rich)

aizynth_synthesis.notes: Real AiZynthFinder MCTS retrosynthesis with SMARTS fallback when AiZynthFinder is not installed.

pl_likelihood.notes: Real Persistent Local Laplacian signature from molmetal.molmetal_lam.lam_chem.pll_signature.

decomp_diff.notes: DecompDiff adapter not yet shipped. Reserved metric name; no mock. Ship molmetal/molmetal_lam/sbdd_env/decompdiff_adapter.py then wire a wrapper.

molcraft.notes: MolCraft adapter not yet shipped. Reserved metric name; no mock. Ship adapter then wire a wrapper.

targetdiff.notes: Real TargetDiff sampler; atom-count is the validity proxy. Swap to a binding-affinity head when shipped.

imold_ood.notes: IMOLDE OOD adapter not yet shipped. Reserved metric; no mock. Ship adapter then wire a wrapper.

drugood_ood.notes: DrugOOD OOD adapter not yet shipped. Reserved metric; no mock. Ship adapter then wire a wrapper.

fallback_conditions.vina_score: no Schrödinger licence — open-source AutoDock Vina is the OSS surrogate

glide_score.notes: Glide requires a Schrödinger licence and is not available in this open-source repo. Use vina_score as the open docking surrogate, or obtain a Glide licence and ship a wrapper.

sa_score.local_check: python -c 'from rdkit.Chem import RDConfig; from rdkit.Chem.Descriptors import _descList; import os; sys_path = os.path.join(RDConfig.RDContribDir, "SA_Score"); sys.path.append(sys_path); import sascorer; print(sascorer.calculateScore("CCO"))'

qed.notes: Real Bickerton drug-likeness 0..1 (8 weighted property aggregator).

flowr.notes: Real FlowER retrosynthesis-flow validity. Adapter under references/FLOWR.

logp7_4.local_check: python -c 'from rdkit.Chem import Crippen; from rdkit import Chem; print(Crippen.MolLogP(Chem.MolFromSmiles("CC(=O)Oc1ccccc1C(=O)O")))'
logp7_4.notes: Real Crippen logP with ionisation correction (alpha7.4 / beta7.4). Heuristic — see TODO/02_metrics/METRICS_TARGETS.md for lit anchors.

gi50_proxy.local_check: python -c 'from rdkit.Chem import Descriptors; from rdkit import Chem; print(Descriptors.MolWt(Chem.MolFromSmiles("CC(=O)Oc1ccccc1C(=O)O")))'
gi50_proxy.notes: Real RDKit-descriptor-based GI50 proxy (-log10[GI50_molair] from Hou 2007). Heuristic — clip [0, 10] downstream.

cell_permeability_logPapp.notes: Real RDKit-descriptor heuristic for logPapp. Lit: Hou 2007.

herg_cardio_risk.notes: Real RDKit SMARTS-rule composite for hERG cardiotox risk.

ames_mutagen.notes: Real RDKit SMARTS-rule-based AMES mutagenicity flag.

hepatotox_index.notes: Real RDKit SMARTS + MW/logP threshold composite for hepatotoxicity risk.

aqueous_solubility_logS.notes: Real ESOL aqueous solubility logS via MW, logP, RB, AP descriptors. Clipped [-12, 2].

plasma_protein_binding.notes: Real Crippen-logP + MW + RB logistic regression on Obach 1999 PPB data.

ring_size_distribution.local_check: python -c 'from rdkit import Chem; m=Chem.MolFromSmiles("c1ccccc1"); print([len(r) for r in m.GetRingInfo().AtomRings()])'
ring_size_distribution.notes: Real RDKit GetRingInfo; per-molecule ring-size histogram in 3-9 + 'other' bins.

pharmacophore_pass_rate.primary_tool: Lipinski Ro5 + Veber (Veber 2002) + RDKit ring-count SMARTS
pharmacophore_pass_rate.local_check: python -c 'from rdkit.Chem import Lipinski; from rdkit import Chem; m=Chem.MolFromSmiles("CC(=O)Oc1ccccc1C(=O)O"); print(Lipinski.NumHDonors(m))'
pharmacophore_pass_rate.notes: Real Lipinski Ro5 + Veber + ring-count composite pass rate.

reference_tanimoto.local_check: python -c 'from rdkit.Chem import AllChem, DataStructs; from rdkit import Chem; m=Chem.MolFromSmiles("CC(=O)Oc1ccccc1C(=O)O"); fp=AllChem.GetMorganFingerprintAsBitVect(m, 2); print(fp.GetNumOnBits())'
reference_tanimoto.notes: Real Morgan-FP Tanimoto distance 1 - sim(cand, ref). Default reference: cisplatin SMILES.

diversity_tanimoto.local_check: python -c 'from rdkit.Chem import AllChem; from rdkit import Chem; m1=Chem.MolFromSmiles("CCO"); m2=Chem.MolFromSmiles("CCN"); fp1=AllChem.GetMorganFingerprintAsBitVect(m1, 2); fp2=AllChem.GetMorganFingerprintAsBitVect(m2, 2); from rdkit.DataStructs import BulkTanimotoSimilarity; print(BulkTanimotoSimilarity(fp1, [fp2]))'
diversity_tanimoto.notes: Mean pairwise Tanimoto distance (1 - similarity) over Morgan FP r=2.

diversity_subpocket.notes: Real per-residue sub-pocket fingerprint diversity (3D-aware local-patch complement to global Tanimoto).

rigid_fragment_rmsd.local_check: python -c 'from rdkit.Chem import AllChem; from rdkit import Chem; m=Chem.MolFromSmiles("CC(=O)Oc1ccccc1C(=O)O"); print(AllChem.CalcRMS(m, m))'
rigid_fragment_rmsd.notes: Real symmetry-aware MCS overlay RMSD (Å) of the maximum common substructure.

com_shift.local_check: python -c 'from rdkit.Chem import AllChem; from rdkit import Chem; m=Chem.MolFromSmiles("CC(=O)Oc1ccccc1C(=O)O"); print(AllChem.CalcRMS(m, m))'
com_shift.notes: Real MMFF94-minimised 3D conformer CoM shift RMSD. Reference conformer from MMFF94s Embed.

metal_compliance.local_check: python -c 'from rdkit import Chem; from rdkit.Chem import rdmolfiles; m=Chem.MolFromSmiles("[Pt]"); print(m.GetNumAtoms())'
metal_compliance.notes: Real SMARTS matching for requested metal centre (Pt/Ru/Ir/Rh/Os/Re/Pd/Au).

metal_coord_compliance.notes: Real SMARTS detection for d-block coordination-shell compliance (square-planar Pt-II, octahedral Pt-IV, …).

coord_geometry_proxy.notes: Phase-4A external scorer was a stub interface in molmetal/molmetal_lam/sbdd_env/metrics_v2.py:870 referencing molmetal_lam.sbdd_env.external_scorers — that module does NOT exist in this repo. Wf-43 Phase 2 marks this MOCK_DELETED. Replace with REAL alternative: molmetal/metal_coord_probe.py for coordination-geometry validity (deterministic, RDKit-based). Update metrics/by_metric/coord_geometry_proxy.json measurements.status field to indicate REDIRECTED.

phototherapy_activity.notes: Phase-4A external scorer was a stub interface. Wf-43 Phase 2 marks this MOCK_DELETED. Real alternative: train an attentive D-MPNN on phototherapy activity labels (no ship in repo). For now, the metric measures a placeholder; remove the JSON from paper §4 until real scorer ships.

ptiv_reduction_potential.notes: Phase-4A external scorer was a stub interface. Wf-43 Phase 2 marks this MOCK_DELETED. Real alternative: Pt(IV) reduction potential DFT surrogate — outside the scope of this repo. Mark REDIRECTED until real ship.

metalloprotein_affinity.notes: Phase-4A external scorer was a stub interface. Wf-43 Phase 2 marks this MOCK_DELETED. Real alternative: bioactivity-LM / D-MPNN on metalloprotein-binding dataset (e.g. metal_cyto, TMQM) — the molmetal/reports/wf_protein_metal_binding/ protein-metal binding CSV at molmetal/data/protein_metal_binding.csv.

model_metrics_NOT_routed_through_score_a._doc: These are model-evaluation AUC / Pearson-r / model-prediction metrics. They are produced by the training script directly (e.g. molmetal/scripts/train_*.py) using a real model checkpoint, NOT through molmetal.scoring.score_any. They are NOT in REGISTRY and are NOT mock — they are D-MPNN/AttentiveFP/etc. inference results.

metrics.notes: Trained on MetalCytoToxDB Ru subset; 5-fold CV ROC-AUC. Real model inference.
Multi-metal leave-one-metal-out on MetalCytoToxDB precious subset.
Same as metal_lomo_auc with broader metals.
Per-task ROC-AUC for the 8 MoleculeNet classification tasks.
DrugOOD OOD ROC-AUC across assay / scaffold / size splits.
Tumor-specific protein-metal binding ROC-AUC v2 (scaffold split).

training_diagnostics_NOT_metrics._doc: These JSONs are training-side observability / dataset-coverage metrics, NOT paper §4 evaluation metrics. They are not routed through score_any and they are not paper-grade.

mock_keys_in_scripts: molmetal/scripts/dock_10pockets_se3sb.py:_stub_score (USED IN PRODUCTION wf30 sweep when is_stub=True)
_summary.mock_audit_action: Wf-43 Phase 2 redirects all 4 Phase-4A external scorers (coord_geometry_proxy, phototherapy_activity, ptiv_reduction_potential, metalloprotein_affinity) to MOCK_DELETED status. The _stub_score function in dock_10pockets_se3sb.py remains ONLY for the bona-fide case where vina/meeko is genuinely missing — when called via score_any() the VinaDockingAdapter import is mandatory and AdapterUnavailable is raised on import failure (NOT a mock substitution).
_summary.test_gate: python -c "from molmetal.scoring.score_any import score_any, ROUTING_POLICY; print(len(ROUTING_POLICY))"
